The '''Fourth Pius Dea Crusade''' was a religious [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusade]] orchestrated by the [[Pius Dea]] cult against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]]. In [[11,920 BBY]], [[11,939 BBY|nineteen years]] after the [[Third Pius Dea Crusade]], the Pius Dea-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sparked another invasion, attacking the region north of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Launching an assault from [[Centares/Legends|Centares]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] moved along the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|Pabol Hutta]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] toward [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and then [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]]. They also launched a fleet from [[Ord Zat]] toward [[The Sundered Veil/Legends|the Sundered Veil]], [[Taskeed/Legends|Taskeed]], [[Dennogra/Legends|Dennogra]], and then the [[Junkfort system|Kossimur system]]; while a fleet from [[Ord Namurt]] moved toward [[Vaathkree/Legends|Vaathkree]], [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], and [[Delacrix/Legends|Delacrix]].<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fourth Pius Dea Crusade was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. While the Fourth Crusade is not mentioned explicitly in the text, it appears on a map of the Crusades and their movement across the galaxy.<ref name="EGW" />
